description: Require noble status and both Venera/Pelageya normal requests completed for first coven entry; preserve existing visits/quest chains and refresh only this saved menu.

edits.new:
! JO9 MOD START WITCH_COVEN_MENU_20261111
if (noble_status = 1 and npc_progress['Venera'] = 2 and npc_progress['Pelageya'] = 2) or (witch_text = 2 or active[$quest[14]] > 0 or active[$quest[15]] > 0 or revolution = 1):
 FUNC('$menu', 'interaction_city', $menu_item_Unfamiliar, 6021, '마녀들의 모임')
else
 FUNC('$menu', 'location_gray_tooltip', $menu_item_Unfamiliar_gray, empty, '마녀들의 모임', '귀족 신분을 얻고 베네라와 펠라게야의 일반 의뢰를 모두 완료해야 합니다.')
end
! JO9 MOD END WITCH_COVEN_MENU_20261111

! JO9 MOD START WITCH_COVEN_ENTRY_20261111
! Existing visits and the special quest chain keep access; no new saved flag.
if interaction_city >= 6021 and interaction_city <= 6024:
 if witch_text ! 2 and active[$quest[14]] <= 0 and active[$quest[15]] <= 0 and revolution ! 1 and (noble_status ! 1 or npc_progress['Venera'] ! 2 or npc_progress['Pelageya'] ! 2): interaction_city = 6031
end
! JO9 MOD END WITCH_COVEN_ENTRY_20261111
IF interaction_city = 6031:
